info.name: Nova Sign Website API
info.description:
Public API for the Nova Sign website ([novasign-sy.com](https://novasign-sy.com/)).

**Base URL**
`{{base_url}}/api/v1/client`

**Locale**
Send `X-Locale: ar` or `X-Locale: en`. Default is `ar`. Every text field in the response follows this header.

**Envelope**
```json
{
  "message": "",
  "status_code": "1000",
  "data": {},
  "errors": null
}
```

The homepage endpoint returns the full single-page site: brand, hero, about, partners, why us, services, portfolio, contact, and SEO.

request.description:
Full homepage payload in Arabic.

`data` shape:
- `brand.name`
- `hero`: `{ key, alt, image }` (`key` is `hero`)
- `about`: `{ title, body }`
- `partners`: `{ title, items[] }` each item `{ id, slug, name, logo, sort_order }`
- `why_us`: `{ title, lead, image, points[] }` each point `{ id, slug, body, sort_order }`
- `services`: `{ title, items[] }` each item `{ id, slug, title, description, image, sort_order }`
- `works`: `{ title, items[] }` each item `{ id, slug, title, image, sort_order }`
- `contact`: `{ title, facebook_link, instagram_link, whatsapp_number, whatsapp_link, contact_numbers, ... }`
- `seo`: `{ title, description }`

Only active records are returned, ordered by `sort_order`.
Same payload as Homepage (Arabic), with English copy.

Social and phone details used in the contact section.

`data`:
- `facebook_link`
- `x_link`
- `instagram_link`
- `snapchat_link`
- `tiktok_link`
- `youtube_link`
- `whatsapp_number`
- `whatsapp_link` (built as `https://wa.me/{digits}`)
- `contact_numbers` (array)

The same object is nested under `contact` on the homepage response.

Localized about text.

`data.value` is the Arabic or English body based on `X-Locale`.

The homepage response already includes this copy under `about.title` and `about.body`.

Stores a message in the dashboard inbox. Returns `201`.

`message_type`: `request` | `suggestion` | `inquiry` | `complaint` | `other`.

`country_code` is a dial code such as `+963`. Leading zeros on `phone` are stripped. The stored phone is `country_code` + `phone`.
